arts.title: In the Blink of an Eye
arts.desc: my first ever digital drawing with ibisPaint. it was supposed to depict me medicated vs unmedicated, and/or how I can go from happy to depressed “in the blink of an eye”. I'm still proud of it to this day.

arts.title: AetherRedrawzs
arts.desc: my own take on Aether, Sleepy's OC and then-persona. named after her Twitch handle, which at the time was AetherDrawzs.

arts.title: Fun in the Snow
arts.desc: this picture depicts Sarah dressed in winter clothes, making a snow angel. I don't remember if I ever officially considered it finished.

arts.title: Two Young Ladies
arts.desc:
this image depicts a child Sarah looking at a ladybug on her hand.
this image still disturbs me today.

arts.title: KISSK
arts.desc: this is another self-portrait. the name was supposed to be an acronym, though for what I don't remember – my best guess is “kind, intelligent, sweet, silly kid”.

arts.title: Sillies Being Silly
arts.desc:
this is an image I drew for Sleepy's birthday. it includes (left to right, top to bottom) Ether, Aether, Sarah, and them. I am happy with how Aether and more so Ether came out. Sarah and Sleepy, not so much.
note: the date is speculation. I lost the original IPV file for this art – the date is based off of the only export I have.

arts.title: Selaso
arts.desc: first ever appearance of Selaso, one of my OCs. since then her appearance has changed a bit, but still mostly the same.

arts.title: Just Sarah.
arts.desc: this is supposed to be a parody of Act 3 of ｢Doki Doki Literature Club!｣ with Sarah, one of my OCs. she is supposed to be sitting in a bean bag, the context being similar to the source material.

arts.title: Aether Aether
arts.desc:
drawing of Sleepy's OC (and then-persona) “Aether” about to make an Aether portal (as in, the ｢Minecraft｣ mod). terible joke, I know.
this artwork is actually the one I'm most proud of. I think it turned out the best. ^.^

arts.translation: lon li nasa • existence is weird
arts.desc:
in this picture, Selaso is laying on her bed having a moment of depression/contemplation.
the thoughts roughly tranlate to “what is existence? why do I exist? everything is wierd.”.

arts.title: relAIxation
arts.desc: a trace of a photograph of the Neuro-sama V2 plushie. the scene is supposed to be a beach.

arts.title: Drawing 8
arts.desc: pixel art traces of the poemgame chibis from ｢Doki Doki Literature Club!｣, using the standard PICO-8 palette.

arts.title: Drawing 7
arts.desc: simple pixel art drawing of Vedal and the Neuro twins using the extended PICO-8 palette. I submitted it to Neurocord and it never got reviewed T-T

arts.title: Drawing 47
arts.desc: Neuro-sama riding a happy ghast from ｢Minecraft｣. another one that was submitted to Neurocord and never reviewed.

arts.title: B
arts.desc:
a more feminized depiction of Selili, this was mostly traced from a drawing of Rosa from ｢Pokémon Black 2 & White 2｣ sourced from Pixiv, the original author of which I can't recall.
I used this as my pfp for a while, until my mom questioned why it “depicted me with breasts”. -_-

albums.title: PICO PICO Literature Club! OST
albums.desc: PICO-8 versions of some of ｢DDLC｣'s OST. I was half-planning on actually demaking it into PICO-8 and using these songs.

albums.title: PICOTALE Soundtrack
albums.desc:
covers of ｢UNDERTALE｣'s soundtrack. I'm slightly more confident these could be made into an actual PICO-8 port in the future than with the ｢DDLC｣ ones because ｢UNDERTALE｣ is more of a game if you get what I mean. still would be a fuckton of effort though.
my goal is to cover at least every boss theme, and some others I like.

songs.title: Bonetrousle
songs.desc:
this song is technically double (± a bit) the speed of the original song, but the notes are also double the normal length, so you'd never notice (I'm like 90% sure there's a music term for this but idk it). this was done so that I could put in the half notes you can hear thoughout the song, which I think make it sound a lot better.
I also thought the song was too short, so I added a bit from the trailer version of the song at the end. I think it works quite well.

songs.title: MEGALOVANIA
songs.desc: between covering ｢LIFE｣ and covering this song, I discovered what WAV files are – raw uncompressed audio. PICO-8 actually exports in WAV by default, I (dumbly) thought WAV was an obscure format that not many programs recognized. so, everything prior to this is MP3. at some point I'll dig up the original P8 files for the rest and reexport as WAV.

songs.title: Metal Crusher
songs.desc:
I am not super happy with this song's cover art for a couple reasons.
the art is meant to depict a hypothetical PICO-8 port of ｢UNDERTALE｣. the HUD being visible means there is text on the art, but this port can't hide it during the enemy's turn for reasons you'd know if you've seen the end of the Genocide route.
also, it just looks bad. unlike the Mettaton sprite (which was custom drawn for this art), the Alphys one is just the one in game scaled down with a few minor tweaks, so it's really ugly.

songs.title: Undertale
songs.desc:
this will probably be my longest cover, unless I decide to do something like ｢Bury the Light｣.
 the art for this one was very fun to make. I actually made it in PICO-8 for once instead of using LibreSprite like I usually do, to make it look like an actual PICO-8 demake of ｢UNDERTALE｣. it was originally gonna include a dialogue box saying the famous line, but I figured having text on it looked ugly. also I really like the human's face on it – they just look so silly :3

songs.title_translation: utala pi kasi Pawi · Flowey fight
songs.desc:
this is a mix of ｢Your Best Nightmare｣ and ｢Finale｣. I always thought the first song/cover of mine to have my voice would be with lyrics. apprarently not.
 I had a lot more fun with this one, strayed a bit farther from the source material than usual. and I think it came out pretty good!

songs.title_translation: utala pi soweli Asuwijo · Asriel fight
songs.desc:
this is a mix of ｢Hopes and Dreams｣ and ｢SAVE the World｣. I am generally very happy with this cover. I feel it sounds very accurate despite all the things removed (I have to remove some stuff because PICO-8 only supports four audio channels).
I'm not super happy with the album art though – as it stands it's just a palette-swap of the flashback. I would've done something with the Asriel's God of Hyperdeath form flying around with the LSD stuff in the back, but it proved to be too much work for me.

albums.title: other covers
albums.desc: all other covers that aren't in their own album

songs.title: LIFE
songs.desc:
this is the first song where I encountered a unique issue: the song didn't fit in one PICO-8 cartridge. I solved this by simply putting the rest (just the last chorus) in a second cartridge and combining the two in Audacity.
I also discovered that PICO-8 can smoothly fade out sound. I can't do it in the audio editor – it's a runtime effect – but it's possible so I allow it.
